anjali: quick sync 10m I'm polishing the changelog for Monday. Need a small before/after snippet for the embeddings migration, plus a couple link fixes and a Known Issues bullet.
mike: which files to touch?
anjali: sdk/js/embeddings.md, sdk/python/embeddings.md, guides/migrations/embed-streaming.md, and changelog/2026-03. Also search for absolute vendor links; canonicalize to docs.redwood.ai.
jun: I'll run linkcheck and patch anchors. Found an old marketplace URL and two moved headings.
mike: I'll add the explicit BEFORE/AFTER code diffs and a tiny sync helper for both JS and Python. Keep examples minimal so they fit the relnotes.
anjali: also include a one-line note about token accounting when switching off streaming and point to Optimize -> batching. And add a Known Issues line: "Dedicated: routing fallbacks to beta variants have caused intermittent 503s; recommend pinning stable model or contacting support."
jun: replaced the absolute links and fixed anchors, pushed a link-only commit.
docs-bot: New PR created: #5740 by mike - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5740
mike: sample I'll add in the changelog (BEFORE / AFTER):
```js
// BEFORE
await client.embeddings.streamCreate({ model: 'embed-old', input })
// AFTER
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-new', input, stream: false })
```
```py
# BEFORE
for chunk in client.embeddings.stream_create(model='embed-old', input=text):
    handle(chunk)
# AFTER
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-new', input=text, stream=False)
vec = resp['data']
```
anjali: perfect. add a one-line FAQ in migration doc: "Disabling streaming can increase token accounting per request; consider batching or prefix/KV caching (see Optimize)."
mike: adding unit tests that exercise the helper so snippet playground won't flake. CI should catch formatting issues.
jun: link commit merged into the branch.
docs-bot: CI started for #5740
anjali: I'll review copy after CI passes. If green, merge and ship the changelog. Tag this thread resolved post-merge.
mike: :thumbsup: watching CI and will revert quickly if anything flakes.
